chapter.li: LEChapter4 Verse1 The manner of their elders and priests administering the flesh and blood of Christ unto the church. And they administered it according to the commandments of Christ; wherefore, we know that the manner to be true. And the elder or priest did minister it; VerseEnd Verse2 and they did kneel down with the church and pray to the Father in the name of Christ, saying, VerseEnd Verse3 O God the Eternal Father, we ask 2PSI thee in the name of 2PSI thy Son Jesus Christ to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it, that they may eat in remembrance of the body of 2PSI thy Son, and witness unto 2PSI thee, O God the Eternal Father, that they are willing to take upon them the name of 2PSI thy Son, and always remember him, and keep his commandments which he hath given them, that they may always have his spirit to be with them. Amen. VerseEnd
